notes: Fifth distinct agent role: skeptical review of all 15 merged records after reading discovery (10), diamond (5), fees (15 patches) and ranking (15 patches). Independently reopened official pages or official indexed text for each venue on 2026-11-16. Only this assigned review file is written.

Seven contribution-language-only high difficulty bands are changed to unknown: Journal of Physics A, Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter, Classical and Quantum Gravity, PCCP, Soft Matter, Journal of Computational Physics and Physical Review E. This reviewer judgment retains demanding contribution criteria and article-type distinctions; it does not equate unknown with easy or turn citation impact into acceptance probability.

Fee outcomes remain ten verified_free and five needs_verification. Independent full-page checks cover the four IOP journal policies, both IUCr sections, both Beilstein journals/shared diamond policy and both TUBITAK journal policies. Verified-free refers to the stated monetary route and applicable article conditions, not eligibility for every manuscript or AI workflow. All IOP/IUCr length rules inspected are editorial conditions, not paid-overlength options.

Access/fee limits remain explicit: RSC PCCP and Soft Matter direct journal retrievals returned HTTP 403; official indexed text supports a free standard route but full ancillary-policy conditions were not recovered. JCP guide retrieval returned HTTP 403; accessible official Elsevier Shop scope supports formats and length only. PRE sources confirm no publication charge but do not separately resolve submission fees; CMP sources confirm no publication/page fee but do not separately resolve submission fees. No route is upgraded from an APC-only statement or inaccessible guide.

All 29 metric objects were inspected, and their numeric values and stated years were independently checked against official sources or official indexed text. Values remain unchanged. MSMSE 2.4 and Journal of Physics A 2.1 remain historical 2024 JIFs from reports published in 2025; their full pages were readable in this review. JPCM 2.9, CQG 3.9, PCCP 3.0 and Soft Matter 2.9 remain 2025 JIFs. JPCM numerical content and both RSC metrics remain indexed-only evidence. No undated JCP numbers, CiteScores, Eigenfactor blocks or unpublished h5 placeholders are added.

IUCr A/B report 2025 rates 62%/64% and submission counts 94/92. Their rate denominators, cohort dates, desk-rejection rules, resubmissions and transfer handling are unspecified. Counts remain independent reported facts; no multiplication, publication/submission ratio, accepted count or manuscript-level chance is inferred. The 2025 rates do not calibrate a cross-specialty difficulty scale.

AI policies independently checked in detail only for the Beilstein and TUBITAK journals. Beilstein distinguishes manuscript preparation from AI-assisted research and restricts generative-image models. TUBITAK limits AI generation of core findings/interpretations, requires verification/meaningful revision of AI text/code and disclosure, and restricts generative manuscript images. Retained AI/ML scientific scope elsewhere does not establish that any particular authoring workflow complies; other full AI-policy subpages were not exhaustively re-audited. Route conditions also retain the stated benign image-adjustment allowance and caption disclosure/case-by-case review for non-generative image tools.

Peer-review and formats were checked on the accessible IOP, IUCr, APS, Beilstein, TUBITAK and CMP policies. RSC review/format evidence was indexed official guidance; JCP current peer-review process details could not be independently recovered from its blocked guide. Existing peer_reviewed type is retained without adding review-anonymity claims. This is an agent policy/evidence review, not human scientific/usability review, venue contact, submission or authorization for new physical laboratory work.
